prompt:
Style references only: the attached images set the painting style, the colours and the mood. Do not copy their content. Paint an equirectangular 360-degree sky panorama for a cozy, bright strategy game: one wide seamless painted sky whose left and right edges join perfectly, ready to wrap around a whole horizon. It is a painting, not a photo, not a 3D render: soft hand-painted brushwork with visible strokes, cheerful and friendly like a storybook toy world, never grim. The horizon runs exactly along the middle height of the image: the top half is sky only, the bottom half carries no ground, no sea and no objects, only the soft warm cream haze of the horizon gently continued and fading downward. No people, no birds, no boats, no text, no labels, no numbers, no letters, no watermark.
 A calm, wide-open sky: the zenith a clear friendly blue (#6cb9f5) that eases lighter and warmer toward the horizon, only two or three small, distant, soft clouds high up, mostly unbroken calm blue, the horizon haze a warm cream (#efe3d0).
label: round 25 sky clear
post: panorama_clear.png is the 16:9 original centre-cropped to 2:1 (80 px off top and bottom) and copied into the game repo as assets/art/sky/panorama_clear.png.
